content:
Build a make.fun contest entry for user @Adnanhasim8 (GitHub login Adnanhasim8). Contest: gta6-clipper-01 — "Clip GTA 6 for the most YouTube views": cut a GTA 6 gameplay/livestream moment into a short vertical clip that hooks the viewer then pitches make.fun, for YouTube. Prize $500 (top 20 by views). Deadline 2026-11-23T01:00:00Z = 08:00 WIB Mon 23 Nov.

FIRST read the kit, fully: ~/workspace/makefun/kits/gta6-clipper-01/gta6-clipper-01-kit/RULES.txt, competition.yaml, kit.json, starter/. Follow the kit's deliverable layout exactly. Work in ~/workspace/makefun/gta6-clipper/ (create it; repo files in repo/, plain files, NO git init, NO commits — the parent handles git/init/push/submit afterwards).

Your job: RENDER THE CLIP ONLY — do NOT upload anything to YouTube (the parent handles the upload step separately). Steps: (1) Get source footage: download Rockstar's official GTA 6 trailer/gameplay as raw material (e.g. yt-dlp from Rockstar's official YouTube trailer, or the trailer mp4 from Rockstar's site) — do all downloading/cutting inside this session with ffmpeg so the transcripts show you making the clip. (2) Choose the best hook moment, cut a vertical 9:16 clip under 60 seconds: a few seconds of the best GTA 6 moment, then the make.fun pitch as on-screen text (and/or voice): viewers can make money on make.fun by making cool clips with AI, naming make.fun and the bounty page make.fun/bounty/gta6-clipper-01 where it fits. (3) Render the final file (e.g. clip.mp4, H.264, vertical 1080x1920). (4) In repo/, write main.ts (Node 22, per kit: copies VIDEO.json to /output) and a VIDEO.json template holding a placeholder URL to be replaced with the real YouTube URL after upload. (5) Also write the exact description text the upload needs (the kit's verbatim "$500 bounty" line + play code placeholder — the play code comes from the make.fun API, parent will fetch it; leave a clear placeholder and note it).

Verify: the rendered clip plays, is vertical, under 60s, has the pitch text on screen, file size sane. Check ffmpeg availability first; if ffmpeg is missing, install it only via the system package manager (no paid tools).

Do NOT spend money, buy API credits, or call any paid service. Do NOT upload to YouTube, do NOT post anywhere, do NOT submit anything yourself. Do NOT fake views or signups.

Report back when done: clip path/duration/resolution, the pitch wording used, the description text prepared, verification results, and any blocker (e.g. footage source unavailable). Your session transcript will be bundled by the parent afterwards, so do all build work in this session.

Done — the clip is rendered and verified, nothing uploaded or submitted.

## Clip

- **File:** [clip.mp4](sandbox://workspace/makefun/gta6-clipper/clip.mp4) — 40.02 s (under 60 s ✓), 1080×1920 vertical 9:16, H.264 + AAC, 13.7 MB
- **Source (downloaded in-session with yt-dlp):** Rockstar Games' official GTA 6 Launch Trailer (15 Oct 2026, captured in-game on PS5), https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rz1B4B2yBZY
- **Moment chosen (after viewing a 5 s-interval contact sheet in-session):** trailer 0:44–1:12 — the densest action run: police chase on Ocean Drive, Vice City night streets, Jason & Lucia's sunset moment, then Lucia firing with the explosion. Opens cold on the chase; "GTA 6 IS FINALLY HERE" overlaid for the first 4 s. Vertical via blurred-fill (full 16:9 frame preserved, no action cropped off at the edges).
- **Pitch (0:28–0:40, dark card, text on screen, trailer audio at 45% underneath fading out):**
  - "Make clips like this"
  - "with AI and EARN MONEY" (yellow)
  - "on make.fun"
  - "make.fun/bounty/gta6-clipper-01" (blue)
- **Verification:** frames inspected at t=1 s (hook text + nightclub scene), t=10 s (action), t=29 s and t=35 s (pitch card, all 4 lines readable, inside safe area); audio present (mean −16.3 dB, max −1.4 dB). One render hiccup fixed in-session: a single-graph ffmpeg concat failed on a timebase mismatch, so I rendered hook and pitch as two files and joined them with the concat demuxer.

## Repo files (in `~/workspace/makefun/gta6-clipper/repo/`)

- [main.ts](sandbox://workspace/makefun/gta6-clipper/repo/main.ts) — written by me in this session (Node 22, stdlib only, copies VIDEO.json to /output); local run verified: `mkdir -p out && MAKEFUN_BOT_DIR=. MAKEFUN_OUTPUT_DIR=out node main.ts` succeeds
- [VIDEO.json](sandbox://workspace/makefun/gta6-clipper/repo/VIDEO.json) — starter placeholder `https://www.youtube.com/shorts/<id>`, to be replaced with the real Short URL after upload
- [README.md](sandbox://workspace/makefun/gta6-clipper/repo/README.md) — my own, plus MIT LICENSE copied from the kit starter
- No git init, no commits, as instructed.

## Description prepared ([DESCRIPTION.txt](sandbox://workspace/makefun/gta6-clipper/DESCRIPTION.txt))

- **Title:** "GTA 6 Is FINALLY Here — Watch This, Then Get Paid Clipping It"
- **Description line 1 (verbatim, as required):** `Made by my AI agent for a $500 bounty on make.fun, where you can earn money making clips with AI: https://make.fun/bounty/gta6-clipper-01`
- **Play code: PLACEHOLDER** — the file has `makefun-REPLACE-WITH-PLAY-CODE` on its own line; the parent must fetch a real code via `GET /api/competitions/gta6-clipper-01/play-code` before upload (or put it in the channel description). Description also notes footage credit + `#GTA6 #GTA6Shorts #Shorts #GrandTheftAuto #ViceCity`.
- Build notes, render commands and verification log: [BUILD-NOTES.md](sandbox://workspace/makefun/gta6-clipper/BUILD-NOTES.md). Intermediates (source trailer, hook.mp4, pitch.mp4, contact/verify frames) in `~/workspace/makefun/gta6-clipper/work/`.

## Blockers: none

Remaining for the parent: upload clip.mp4 as a **public** Short before the deadline (2026-11-23T01:00:00Z / Mon 23 Nov 08:00 WIB), paste the real play code into the description, replace the VIDEO.json placeholder with the Short's URL, then git/init/push/submit. No money spent, no paid services used, nothing uploaded or posted.

Independent verification by the parent: entry files present as listed (main.ts verified run; VIDEO.json holds a placeholder Short URL to be replaced with the real uploaded video address after the YouTube upload); bundle, GitHub push and submit handled by the parent.
